subtasks.title: Domain model and pure mutations
subtasks.description: Implement project/task/settings types and pure functions for create, update, delete, tag normalization (trim, case-insensitive unique, max 10), title/name validation, default Inbox when the last project is removed, completedAt on toggle, and injectable-clock overdue/due-today helpers. No UI or storage yet.
verification: Creating a title-only task yields priority none, dueDate null, tags [], completed false.
Completing sets completedAt; uncompleting clears it.
Adding tags work and Work stores a single tag.
Deleting the last project recreates Inbox.
Overdue helper with a fixed yesterday date returns overdue only when incomplete.

subtasks.title: localStorage persistence layer
subtasks.description: Serialize and deserialize a namespaced payload (todo-app:v1) with version, projects, tasks, and settings. Default missing fields, recover from invalid JSON/schema without throwing, write after mutations (debounce <= 300ms), and ignore or merge cross-tab storage events without corrupting state.
verification: Round-trip of sample projects and tasks restores fields including order.
Corrupt JSON loads default Inbox state without throwing.
Missing optional fields get documented defaults.
QuotaExceededError is catchable by the caller rather than crashing.

subtasks.title: App shell, landmarks, and theme
subtasks.description: Add index.html shell with one h1, banner/navigation/main landmarks, header (app name, theme control, add-task), and CSS variables for light/dark. Theme supports light, dark, and system; persist choice; apply before or with first paint to avoid a light flash. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
verification: Selecting Dark, reloading, shows Dark with no wrong-theme flash.
System follows prefers-color-scheme when that option is selected.
Primary text, borders, and controls remain visible in both themes.
prefers-reduced-motion disables CSS transitions.

subtasks.title: Projects sidebar CRUD
subtasks.description: UI to list, create, rename, delete, and select projects or All projects. Confirm before delete (removes that project's tasks). Reject case-insensitive duplicate names with an inline error. Persist activeProjectId. Desktop sidebar; mobile disclosure/drawer/tabs.
verification: Empty storage first load shows selected Inbox.
Confirmed delete removes the project's tasks and selects another project or new Inbox.
Duplicate name (different case) shows an inline error and does not create.
Active project is restored after reload.

subtasks.title: Task create, edit, complete, delete
subtasks.description: Add and edit tasks with title, notes, project, priority, due date, and tags (Enter/comma commit). Checkbox toggles complete. Empty title cannot save (invalid + focus). Delete uses confirm dialog or undo toast within 5s. Live region announces add/delete/complete. Checkbox accessible name includes title.
verification: Title-only create appears in the list with default fields.
Empty title save is blocked and the title field is focused.
Complete then reload keeps completed true and completedAt.
Delete confirm or 5s undo removes the task; aria-live announces the change.

subtasks.title: Priority, due date, and tag presentation
subtasks.description: Show priority as text-equivalent badge (not color-only). Format due dates locally; mark incomplete past due as Overdue and today as Due today; never overdue when completed. Tag chips on rows; used-tag list; clicking a tag applies that tag filter. Clearing due date stores null.
verification: High incomplete tasks have a non-color cue plus visible High text.
Incomplete task due yesterday shows Overdue; completing removes it.
Clearing due date removes labels and persists null.
Clicking tag home filters to tasks that include home.

subtasks.title: Filtering, search, and empty states
subtasks.description: AND filters for project, status, priority subset, tags (every selected), due bucket, and case-insensitive search on title/notes/tags. Visible active-filter chips, one-click clear all, debounce search >=150ms. Empty first-visit hint and no-match empty state with clear action. First-visit Inbox copy: Add your first task.
verification: Status=active AND Priority=high among mixed sample tasks shows only the active-high task.
Query milk matches title Buy milk and a milk tag.
Clear filters restores the current project list.
No matches shows empty copy and a working clear-filters control.

subtasks.title: Manual drag-and-drop and keyboard reorder
subtasks.description: Pointer drag reorders visible tasks and persists order. Ignore drag when sort is not manual. Each row has Move up/down (or equivalent) that swaps with the previous/next visible task. Hidden tasks keep stored order. Touch targets for move/complete/delete/add >= 40x40 CSS px.
verification: Dragging A above B keeps A above B after drop and reload.
Keyboard Move up swaps with the previous visible task.
Filtering or completing does not scramble hidden tasks' order values.
Drag is ignored when sort mode is not manual.

subtasks.title: Responsive layout and accessibility polish
subtasks.description: Desktop >=768px sidebar + list; 320px usable with no overlap or horizontal scroll; titles wrap at 768/1280. Visible focus rings, labeled fields, dialog focus trap/Escape/restore, WCAG 2.2 AA contrast both themes, QuotaExceededError banner without wiping UI. Keyboard-only path: create, complete, filter by project, delete.
verification: 320px: primary actions reachable, no overlapping controls.
768px+: sidebar visible; task titles wrap.
Keyboard-only can create, complete, filter by project, and delete.
QuotaExceededError shows a non-blocking banner and keeps on-screen data.

subtasks.title: Automated tests and README
subtasks.description: Documented npm test (or equivalent) with unit coverage for mutations, filters, reorder, persistence round-trip, overdue clock, and tags; UI/e2e for add+reload, complete, filter clear, theme persist, and keyboard add or complete. README explains open/build and test commands. No remote server required.
verification: npm test (or documented command) passes locally without a remote server.
Unit suite includes filter combinations, order updates, serialize round-trip, injectable-clock due helpers, and tag uniqueness.
UI suite covers add+rehydrate, toggle complete, filter clear, theme persist, and a keyboard path.
README documents how to open or build the app and how to run tests.
